stories.title: The Rescuer of Frost Peak
stories.question: Can a lone mountain tracker reach a trapped climber before the blizzard cuts off the descent?
stories.answer: Yes, by utilizing an emergency signal flare to guide the rescue helicopter through the blinding alpine snow.

story_beats.headline: The Hidden Signal
story_beats.speech: I see the faint blinking emergency beacon through the dense whiteout up near the north ridge.
story_beats.label: Emergency Spotted
story_beats.visual_prompt: Elena stands on the edge of a snowy cliffside, holding the rescue_radio in her gloved right hand, staring up at a distant blinking red signal in the dark sky.

story_beats.headline: Ascending the Ridge
story_beats.speech: The wind is howling fiercely, but I am closing the distance to the stranded climber now.
story_beats.label: The Climb
story_beats.visual_prompt: Elena battles a fierce blizzard, climbing a steep icy slope surrounded by snow-dusted pine trees, gripping her ice axe firmly with both hands.

story_beats.headline: Reaching the Shelter
story_beats.speech: Hang on just a little longer, Liam! I have reached your ledge and brought warm thermal blankets.
story_beats.label: The Contact
story_beats.visual_prompt: Elena kneels next to Liam under a rocky overhang, wrapping a silver thermal blanket around his shoulders while holding the signal_flare in her left hand.

story_beats.headline: Guidance Through the Storm
story_beats.speech: Igniting the emergency flare now so the rescue chopper can lock onto our exact position safely.
story_beats.label: The Extraction
story_beats.visual_prompt: Elena and Liam stand together on the snowy peak under a starry midnight sky, watching a bright crimson flare illuminate the clouds as a rescue helicopter approaches.

visual_bible.style: Cinematic live-action photography with cold blue tones, visible breath vapor, and dramatic mountain lighting.

characters.elena: A seasoned mountain rescue specialist in her late 30s with weathered skin, steady blue eyes, wearing a heavy crimson parka, thermal goggles resting on her forehead, and professional alpine climbing gear.
characters.liam: A stranded hiker in his late 20s, exhausted and shivering, wearing a torn yellow jacket dusted with fresh snow, huddled against a granite rock wall.

locations.summit_ledge: A steep, wind-scoured granite cliffside at high altitude, surrounded by jagged peaks and thick swirling mist.
locations.valley_base: A snowy alpine basin framed by dense pine forests and steep icy ridges.

objects.signal_flare: A heavy steel emergency flare canister emitting a bright, intense crimson beam and thick white smoke.
objects.rescue_radio: A rugged black military-grade handheld transceiver with a short rubber antenna and a frost-covered keypad.
